latest.text:
Tiafoe beat Cobolli 7–6, 6–0 in his second group match in Turin to win his first match at this event. It was the first appearance here for both players and Cobolli played it at home.

The first set was a real fight. Cobolli broke in the opening game and Tiafoe only got level at 3–3. Tiafoe then had a set point on Cobolli's serve but Cobolli saved it and forced a tiebreak. Tiafoe took that tiebreak 8–6. For him, the break back was the moment the set changed: "Just fighting. Like, you know, I felt like after I got the break back, I was a better player in the set." After the tiebreak, Cobolli did not win another game. Tiafoe broke three times and took the second set 6–0.

That second set was built on his return. He won 35% of the points against the first serve, far above his usual 26%.

Credit to him: in his first appearance at this event, he beat the home player on a fast indoor court, with a dominance ratio of 1.64. Medvedev waits in his last group match.

commentary.text: Cobolli made a fast start, breaking Tiafoe's serve to love in the opening game. Tiafoe was close to falling behind 4-1 with a double break in the first set but fought back to level. He then came back from 4-6 down in the tiebreak to take the first set and that comeback proved to be the key to the match. Tiafoe broke early in the second set, kept improving and pulled away, while Cobolli had a tough night. Tiafoe kept his emotions under control in a loud arena in Turin and handled both the occasion and the crowd to win on his debut at the ATP Finals.
